name: Korbo's Donut Shop
author: Korbosoft
description_long: Korbo's world-famous donut shop is always open! Donut shop might not actually be world-famous. None of this would have ever happened without Wii Donut by emilydaemon, and xOx-Liy-Codez-XD-oXo helped me a ton getting the rewrite to initially work. Music can be changed by adding a mod/it/s3m/xm/whatever tracker module in the music directory. This program supports most tracker music formats; https://modarchive.org is a good source.
